content.description: Illustration showing a fastener attached to a surface with adhesive

items: (b) Cut the old adhesive off around the fastener installation area.

content.description: Two illustrations showing hands cleaning glass - first removing urethane gum with a scraper, second cleaning with cloth

items: (a) Using a scraper, remove the urethane gum sticking to the glass.

content.description: Illustration of windshield showing position marks and spacers at corners

items: (b) Place the glass in correct position onto rubber spacers.
(c) Check that all contacting parts of the glass rim are perfectly even and do not make contact with the retaining clips.
(d) Make reference marks between the glass and body.

content.description: Illustration showing hand with brush cleaning contact surface around glass rim

content.text: Using alcohol or similar solvent, clean contact surface 15 – 30 mm (0.59 – 1.18 in.) wide around the entire glass rim.

content.description: Cross-section diagram showing dam installation with double-stick tape at 9.5mm from glass rim, and detail view of corner fold with V-wedge cut

items: (a) Apply double-stick tape at a point 9.5 mm (0.37 in.) from the glass rim.
(b) Place the dam on the double-stick tape.

content.text: NOTE: Cut a V-wedge into the corner folds of the dam.
CAUTION: Do not touch the glass face after cleaning it.
